Geometry · Unit 1: Foundations of Geometry

Segments and Angles

Measure and construct segments and angles; use the segment and angle addition postulates.

What you’ll learn

  • Use the segment addition postulate
  • Measure and classify angles
  • Use the angle addition postulate

The mountain biking connection

Head-tube and seat-tube angles are the first numbers on any bike geometry chart.
